subject: Pricing follow-up: Renewal volume step-ups & blended rates
messages:
From: Sarah Jansen <sarah.jansen@acmehealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acmehealth.com>; procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2025-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up: Renewal/Expansion pricing - volume details

Thanks for the time today, Marissa - quick follow-up from Tom and me. We had a productive call; two asks to unblock procurement: a) can you confirm how you model stepped pricing as we move from our current committed 25M tokens/mo to a potential 150-300M tokens/mo over 12 months, and b) what a blended rate might look like if we add the new embeddings route and two additional generation routes (different model flavors)?

For context, Tom wants to target a blended budget in the neighborhood of $12- $15 per 1M tokens (post-discount). We also need visibility into unit economics at the different tiers (recommended list rates vs. committed volumes) so procurement can build a SOW.

Can you send a short recap with proposed tiers, blended example, and next steps?

- Sarah
Security & Integrations, Acme Health

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Sarah Jansen <sarah.jansen@acmehealth.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-15T11:06:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Renewal/Expansion pricing - volume details

Hi Sarah / Tom - great to meet you both today. Below is a concise post-call recap and a pricing sketch to move procurement forward. I attached a one-page proposal and an Excel with the usage assumptions we discussed.

Post-call recap (high level)
- Current committed volume: ~25M tokens/month (currently on Standard gen route)
- Expansion ask: add two gen routes (Model A for shorter responses, Model B for long-form) + embeddings route for semantic search
- Timeline: ramp to ~150M tokens/mo by month 6, and up to ~300M tokens/mo by month 12 (phased)

Pricing sketch (per 1M tokens) - list / typical discount patterns
- Tier 1: 0-50M/mo: $20 per 1M tokens (list) - example committed rate: $18/1M
- Tier 2: 50-200M/mo: $14 per 1M tokens (list) - example committed rate: $12/1M
- Tier 3: 200M+ /mo: $11 per 1M tokens (list) - example committed rate: $9- $10/1M

Blended example (month of 150M tokens; mix: 60% gen routes / 40% embeddings for cost modeling)
- Billable tokens: 150M
- Applied tiers: 50M @ $18 + 100M @ $12 = (50*$18 + 100*$12) / 150 = blended ~$13.33 per 1M
- If embeddings are a higher unit cost, we can model route-specific weights (I included a per-route column in the attached Excel).

Volume step-ups & blended discounts
- We can offer stepped committed pricing that reduces the blended rate as you cross thresholds (e.g., guaranteed 12/1M once you hit 50M committed, and 10/1M at 200M committed).
- For renewal: we recommend a 12-month commit with quarterly volume re-forecast checkpoints to adjust routing/quantization profiles to optimize spend.

Next steps
1) I attached a short proposal and the usage workbook - please review and share with procurement.
2) If this hits the target blended range ($12- $15/1M), I'll draft a formal renewal addendum and run final pricing with finance (cc Rishi).
3) Tom - can you confirm the expected fraction of embeddings vs gen tokens at steady state? That will change the blended number.

Thanks - I can turn this into a formal quote by EOD Wednesday if procurement is ready.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Sarah Jansen <sarah.jansen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2025-11-15T14:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Renewal/Expansion pricing - volume details

Thanks Marissa - that looks aligned with what we need. Quick answers: steady-state we expect ~30-35% embeddings, remainder gen routes (split roughly 60/40 between Model A and Model B). Procurement wants to see an example blended invoice and a proposed SOW clause that allows for quarter-by-quarter volume reconciliation.

If you can get the draft addendum and an example invoice by Wednesday EOD that would be ideal.

- Tom
CTO, Acme Health

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acmehealth.com>, Sarah Jansen <sarah.jansen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-17T09:33:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Renewal/Expansion pricing - volume details

Tom / Sarah - attaching the draft addendum and example invoice (see Redwood-proposal-v1.pdf and acme-usage-estimates.xlsx). Highlights:
- Draft addendum: 12-month committed term with step-up bands at 50M and 200M tokens/month, quarterly reconciliation and a 60-day forecast cadence
- Example invoice: shows blended math and per-route breakout; line items include committed discount, overage tiers, and a one-time onboarding credit we can apply for the renewal

Internal note (cc Rishi & Dev): please review the attached and confirm finance can approve the example blended rates (12/1M at 50M+, 10/1M at 200M+). Also confirm whether we can offer a 5% onboarding credit on year-one committed volume.

Next steps for Acme: procurement to confirm internal approval and send any redlines. We will prepare a final quote and order form upon their signoff.

Marissa

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-18T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up: Renewal/Expansion pricing - volume details

Thanks for the context + attachments. Quick internal: finance confirms we can approve the committed example rates as long as the volume forecasts are included in the contract and there's a clause for quarterly reconciliations. 5% onboarding credit ok for year one only.

I'll prepare the finalized quote and order form tomorrow and run it past Legal for the reconciliation language. Marissa - I'll hand back to you to send to Acme once final.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
